description: Tiny, fast, Linux-compatible sandboxes. Powered by WebAssembly.

latest_release.name: v0.4.9
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* feat(v8-runtime): add opt-in Wasm exnref exception handling by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2111
* perf!: cycle VMs 4× faster, 10× VM throughput, and add module snapshots by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2109
* fix(gawk): exit a BEGIN-only awk program without reading input by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2113
* fix(native-sidecar): give exec and execFile end of input after their stdin by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2112
* fix(native-sidecar): never reject teardown on a full request queue by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2114
* fix(native-sidecar): wait for rejection room before routing priority requests by @eersnington in https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/pull/2115


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/rivet-dev/agentos/compare/v0.4.8...v0.4.9

hot_issues.title: Guest `node` ignores stdin as the program, and `node --input-type=module` reading stdin reports "command not found: node"
Docs validation gates reference the removed website/ directory and cannot run
Network permission rule sets never match; explicit permission objects also bypass the documented merge-over-default
Pi file-writing turn fails with Actor SQLite transaction timeout on local native runtime
Sidecar serializes all agent prompts per process: a second session's prompt cannot start until the active turn completes (across sessions and VMs)
Interactive PTY: tab completion does nothing in the VM shell
ACP session dies mid-run: bufferedBytes saturates at whatever limits.acp ceiling is set (64 MiB and 256 MiB), with kilobytes of actual traffic
